asl: Use extremely plus the adjective, not as hell.
bbg: Each occurrence can mean sweetheart or I had better go. Preserve the endearment and departure separately.
beige_flag: Preserve the described habit. A harmless unremarkable quirk is not a bad place.
big_back: A weight/eating-related insult, not merely rude behavior.
breadcrumbing: Giving intermittent attention without commitment. Do not invent a recipient or third person.
cap: In no cap it emphasizes truthfulness. A cap worn on the head or on a bottle is literal.
chat: An address to an audience: everyone. Preserve the question to that audience.
dap: A friendly greeting hand slap, handshake or fist bump, not asking for help.
faded: Intoxicated; do not use the ambiguous standalone word high.
ffa: Every player competes against every other player independently, not free of charge.
flavored_air: Using an electronic cigarette, not a sound or plain air.
fml: Strong frustration with life; no asterisks or unexplained acronym.
frfr: Emphasizes sincerity: I really mean it.
lms: Like my post. Preserve any following condition or request.
ong: Emphasizes truthfulness: I swear it is true.
plug: A supplier of hard-to-find goods, unless the context explicitly supports drugs. Electrical plugs are literal.
pmoys: The sender requests that the recipient add the sender on Snapchat. Keep that direction.
pwn: Being thoroughly defeated. For a test, performing terribly on it.
real: Be serious. Pull off clothing means look good wearing it, not attract romantic partners.
rizz: Ability to attract romantic interest. Not being good toward attractive people.
rotflmao: Laughing extremely hard. Do not output censored asterisks.
unc: A joke about getting or seeming old, not literally becoming an uncle.
upper_decky: A nicotine pouch under the upper lip, not an unexplained brand.
zombie: A person who resumes contact after disappearing. Do not keep the undead metaphor unexplained.
skibidi_toilet: Keep the series title as a proper name, without replacing it with its plot.
